plot(sameday_sp$gam,  scale = 0)

#coldwarm should be removed, highly collinear with COSTIME (representative of WINTER and SUMMER)

sameday_sp2 <- gamm(log(SBP) ~ BC24H + BMI + WARMCOLD + s(AGE) + TEMPC24H  + s(RHUM24H) + as.factor(RACE) + TWODRINK + CHD + DIABETE + as.factor(SMK) + as.factor(FBG) + NEDUC + STATIN + SINETIME + COSTIME + as.factor(WKDAY), na.action = na.omit, random = list(ID =  ~ 1 + VISIT), family = gaussian(), data = nas)
plot(sameday_sp2$gam,  scale = 0)

summary(sameday_sp2$lme)
